verdict.rationale: Rippling shows scattered natural-language entry points—an AI dashboard prompt ('Show me headcount vs plan'), AI-built reports on labor trends, and an AI assistant answering employee benefits questions—but these are narrow, feature-specific NL interactions rather than a general natural-language interface for operating the whole platform (payroll, HR, IT, integrations).missing for 10: evidence of NL commands controlling core admin actions (running payroll, managing permissions, provisioning apps), a documented conversational agent/chat interface spanning the product, and independent hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as described.
